data.one_liner: A Flutter widget for creating a vertical carousel with stacked cards.
data.what_it_does: It provides a customizable `StackedCardCarousel` widget that renders a vertical list of cards in a stacked or fade-out animation style. Developers can pass a list of card widgets, configure spacing, initial offsets, and page controllers.
use_when: You need a vertical card carousel with a stacked effect in your UI.
You want to display a sequence of cards with built-in transition types like cardsStack or fadeOutStack.
avoid_when: You need a horizontal carousel layout.
You require complex, highly customized physics outside of the built-in parameters.
strengths: Easy to set up with standard widget parameters.
Supports multiple carousel types and custom page controllers.
weaknesses: Limited to vertical layout style as described by its purpose.
Minimal advanced configuration options outside of the documented attributes.
